ui.pageTitle: My Canadian Stock - Sherbrooke | Liquidation Deals
ui.pageDescription: My Canadian Stock in downtown Sherbrooke offers liquidation deals, new arrivals every Saturday, daily price drops, and products from major retailers.
ui.hero.description: Great products, great value, right here in Sherbrooke.
ui.about.title: A treasure hunt, every visit
ui.about.intro: My Canadian Stock is a local business in downtown Sherbrooke, specializing in liquidation merchandise from Amazon, Walmart, Costco, Canadian Tire, and other major retailers.
ui.about.notice: Inventory and prices change quickly. Items and quantities are limited, so each visit can bring a different find.
ui.categories.title: A little bit of everything
ui.policy.eyebrow: Good to know before you buy
ui.policy.text: Please inspect and test items before leaving. For purchases over $5, report defects or missing parts within 24 hours (by closing the next day) for an exchange or store credit. Cash refunds and change-of-mind returns are not accepted. Clothing and shoes are final sale.
ui.hours.title: Store hours
ui.hours.subtitle: We look forward to welcoming you.
ui.contact.title: Contact us
ui.contact.description: Have a question? We would be happy to help.
ui.location.title: Find us

cards.title: Overstock & open-box finds
cards.body: Find new, open-box, and customer-returned products sourced from major retailers, overstock, refused deliveries, store closures, and seasonal clearances.

cards.title: A testing area in store
cards.body: Want to check an item before buying? Open the box, inspect the contents, and test the product when possible. We encourage you to make sure the main parts and accessories are included before checkout.

cards.title: A real treasure hunt
cards.body: Everything is first come, first served. Products are unique, quantities are limited, and the best finds go quickly. Every visit brings something different.

cards.title: Fresh stock every Saturday
cards.body: New weekly inventory goes on the shelves every Saturday. This is when the most interesting, rare, or valuable items arrive, so prices are at their highest.

cards.title: Prices drop all week
cards.body: Prices gradually decrease based on what remains. The usual range is $25 on Saturday down to as little as $1 on Friday, adjusted according to quantity, quality, and demand. Higher-priced items are different: their price is generally fixed at about 50% off the regular in-store price.
